every one of the 2,572,802 windows has all three QC inputs on file (0 missing a pass fraction, a coverage or a possible count), so the filter can be re-evaluated everywhere rather than assumed

FORWARD DIRECTION: all 1,984,900 scored windows satisfy the published filter when it is re-evaluated from the raw pass/coverage/possible inputs -- 0 violate it, so nothing was admitted in spite of the rule the Methods state

the margins agree: over the scored set the pass fraction bottoms out at 0.8000, coverage spans 25.003-34.862 and `possible` bottoms out at 1,000 -- and the 1,723 windows at exactly 0.8 confirm the comparison is >=, not >

REVERSE DIRECTION: 98.1% of absent windows fail at least one of the paper's three conditions (threshold 95%); the residual 10,921 pass all three and are unexplained, so the filter is not a complete account of membership
absence is the PASS-fraction rule, not missing coverage: 417,097 windows fail >= 80% PASS against 19,396 failing the 25-35x band -- so 'no gnomAD coverage' is the wrong name for this stratum
the same holds site-weighted, which is what panel C's third band counts: of its 537,985 sites, 87.8% are in windows failing the PASS rule against 1.0% failing coverage

the training join loses nothing: 0 of the dnm1 sites lack a feature row, and the 2,762 feature-only loci are all autosomal, so no site trains on nulls
